new_unit_fault: Receipt-insert trigger abort in a temporary database; successful rollback, not mid-commit process termination.
identity_binding_boundary: Successful retained receipts bind arguments; rejected attempts do not reserve the identity. Confirmed by a separate unit test, not included in84cases.

frozen_spec_clarification.unqualified_text: changed arguments under same operation id rejected
frozen_spec_clarification.clarification: Argument binding starts when a successful receipt is retained. A rejected attempt creates no reservation; revised arguments can later succeed under that identifier.

atomicity_unit_scope: SQLite receipt-insert abort rolls back mutation/audit; no mid-commit process or power-loss test.
receipt_granularity_scope: This extension uses per-operation receipts atomic with the effect. Original factorial R is a separate-store whole-intent completion receipt.
